editorial_contributions.text: Summary: We present a survey of the state of knowledge concerning the chromatic number of regions of \(\mathbb{R}^2\) bounded by a circle or by two parallel lines. Several of the designs we describe are hitherto unpublished and improve on previously known bounds. The authorship denotes that this work is a product of the Polymath 16 project.
